LD2188 hjá Þróunarbanka Evrópuráðsins (e. Council of Europe Development Bank, CEB). Lántakan fellur undir lántökuáætlun samkvæmt fjárhagsáætlun. Í krónum næmi lántakan um 3,4 milljörðum króna. Jafnframt er lagt til að fjármála- og áhættustýringarsviði verði veitt heimild til að semja við innlend fjármálafyrirtæki um gjaldeyrisvarnir vegna lántökunnar, að hluta eða öllu leyti. Greinargerð fylgir tillögunni. Samþykkt. Bjar

records.title: Arctic Fish (AFISH): Q3 2026 - Previous volume record surpassed
records.summary: 15,613 tonnes harvested YTD 2026, up 48% from 10,561 tonnes YTD 2025. Full-year record from 2025 (14,791 tonnes) already surpassed after nine months. Quarterly harvest volumes amounted to 4.0 thousand tonnes, compared with 5.4 thousand tonnes in Q3 2025 (-26% YoY). Revenues amounted to EUR 22.8 million, compared with EUR 29.0 million in Q3 2025, driven by lower harvest volumes. Negative Operational EBIT of EUR -4.2 million, compared to -6.6 MEUR in Q3 2025 showing operational improvements on lower volumes compared to last year.
